description: Kaagaz: run infra/ec2/deploy.sh for one service (CI/CD Phase 3). The only command GitHub's deploy role may run on the server.

tag.description: The image's commit id (40 hex characters)

mode.description: deploy: config from the commit, the schema must match. rollback: current config, a newer schema accepted.

runCommand: if [ '{{ mode }}' = rollback ]; then set -- --rollback; else set --; fi
